title: terragucci.state-edges/v1
description: edges.json in a project's directory of a reports prefix: for each root, the roots whose state it reads, the newest run that planned it and the newest tf-apply wave that changed it. Root paths and run facts, never a state's contents or an output's value. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

path.description: The run's directory, relative to the project's index.json.

pull_request.description: The pull or merge request a plan was for.

version_id.description: An apply: the state version it left, when the backend keeps versions.

reads.description: The roots whose state it reads, as the newest default-branch run found them in its code.

reads_seen.description: When the run that found its reads finished.

planned.description: The newest run that planned it: a pull request's plan, a drift check or an apply wave's plan.

applied.description: The newest tf-apply wave that changed one of its resources.
